options.hoka_odyssey.vertical.tooltip: How many cubes (16 blocks each) above and below you to load and render on Hoka Odyssey cubic-chunk maps. Horizontal distance is the usual Render Distance. Higher sees further up and down but costs memory, traffic and performance. The server may cap it.
options.hoka_odyssey.surface.tooltip: On Hoka Odyssey cubic-chunk maps, distant peaks, slopes and cliffs stay visible beyond Vertical Distance — up to this many cubes (16 blocks each) above and below you. Only the surface is loaded: mountain interiors and empty sky are not. Higher shows taller mountains at a small memory and performance cost. Off — only the vertical window, as before.
options.hoka_odyssey.cube_cache.tooltip: How much memory to keep for cubes that left your view on Hoka Odyssey cubic-chunk maps. Coming back shows them instantly instead of downloading again; changed cubes are re-sent by the server. 0 turns the cache off.
options.hoka_odyssey.client_gen.tooltip: On Hoka Odyssey maps whose generator can run on your computer, untouched terrain is generated locally instead of being downloaded: the world loads much faster after teleports and uses far less traffic. Places changed by players still come from the server. Auto uses your CPU cores minus one (at least 2); Off downloads everything as before.
options.hoka_odyssey.gen_disk.tooltip: How much disk space to keep for terrain generated on your computer. When you rejoin or come back to known places it is read from disk instantly instead of being generated again. The oldest data is removed automatically when the space runs out. 0 turns it off.
options.hoka_odyssey.lod.tooltip: On Hoka Odyssey maps the world beyond Render Distance is shown simplified — mountains, forests and water up to the horizon. The farther away, the coarser. Computed on your computer from the planet generator (no network), kept in video memory. Off — as before.
options.hoka_odyssey.lod_quality.tooltip: How early distant places get coarser. Higher — more detail far away, more video memory and CPU work.
options.hoka_odyssey.lod_body.tooltip: In space, asteroids beyond Render Distance are shown simplified (shape, ores, textures) without cut edges. Off — normal rendering only.
options.hoka_odyssey.lod_body_quality.to: How detailed distant asteroids are. Higher — more accurate shape, more memory and GPU work.
options.hoka_odyssey.smooth.tooltip: Even frame pacing: frames are presented on a strict time grid under a cap the game can hold almost always — no 300↔900 swings. "Up to N" never exceeds N (steps lower if it cannot hold). "Auto" has no cap, "Stable" is even smoother at lower FPS. Inactive with VSync.
